speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You've mentioned experiencing unusual behavior and believing you can communicate telepathically with animals; to better understand this, have these feelings been present continuously or do they come and go?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old male. The patient presents with a chief complaint of 'failing health.' He reports an inability to communicate telepathically with animals, which he believes he could previously do, affected by the current weather conditions. He has started taking assorted Peruvian herbs without any improvement. He denies taking any medications. The symptoms have been ongoing for the past eight months.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Delusional Misidentification Syndrome with somatic delusions of "failing health" and loss of a purported telepathic ability, likely secondary to a primary psychotic disorder such as schizophrenia or substance-induced psychosis.
